notes: TBox rule over has_angle_sum (functional). Only the surveyor's plot (a new member) is dl; the other queries compute angles.

queries.not_checked: fol (arithmetic): the third angle from the other two
fol (arithmetic): dividing the angle sum by three

fol.notes: The angle sum and the angles are real-valued attributes; the rule is a ForAll over shapes (linear). The stored values for the equilateral and right triangle give way (top-level gives_up), as q2's and q3's chains say.

three_angles.says: A triangle's angle sum is the sum of its three interior angles.
three_angles.z3: All(t, [klm, eq_tri, right_tri], angle(t, 1) + angle(t, 2) + angle(t, 3) == angle_sum(t))

eq_def.says: An equilateral triangle is a triangle in a plane whose three interior angles are equal.

right_def.says: A right triangle is a triangle in a plane with one interior angle of 90 degrees.

eq_60.says: Each interior angle of an equilateral triangle is 60 degrees. (stored)

right_90.says: The two acute angles of a right triangle add up to 90 degrees. (stored)

klm.says: Triangle KLM is a triangle drawn on a flat sheet of paper, with angles of 50 and 60 degrees.
